verdict.rationale: Wave documents a double-entry ledger with Pro-plan bank feeds that automatically import, merge, and categorize bank transactions. "Merge" hints at matching or de-duplicating imported transactions against existing records, but no reconciliation workflow is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit per-account bank reconciliation feature, surfacing of matched vs. unmatched transactions for review, explicit duplicate detection/review, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
